STRUCTURAL INSIGHT: the S3 adv_resistance formula 1 - |f_clean - f_adv|/(f_clean + 0.05) measures clean-adv SIMILARITY, not absolute adv robustness — when f_clean improves alone (0.0918->0.0675) with f_adv unchanged (~0.098), the divergence widens (0.031/0.117=0.265) and resistance drops mechanically. The 0.0243 clean-sub gain is eaten by 0.10 * 0.218 = +0.0218 adv contribution, netting only 0.00288. Per-pass tuning is STRICTLY DISADVANTAGED under the current adv_resistance definition — any improvement that doesn't propagate to adv produces artifactual resistance loss.
